about: What the world map (scripts/worldmap.mjs -> docs/worldmap.png) can't read from the game: names, and things decided or planned but not built. Everything built is read from the world itself and needs nothing here. Coordinates are world metres (x, z).

kinds.place: a name on the map: { kind, name, x, z }
kinds.planned: a thing not built yet, drawn hollow: { kind, name, x, z, r? }
kinds.zone: an area, outlined and named: { kind, name, pts: [[x, z], ...] } or { kind, name, x, z, r }
kinds.crossing: a way from one zone to the next: { kind, name, pts: [[x, z], [x, z]] }
kinds.line: any other line: { kind, name, pts: [[x, z], ...] }
